title: Trajectory Conformance Test Fixture
description: Defines the structure of conformance test fixture files consumed by engine implementations.

test_id.description: Unique test identifier. Prefix: val- (validation), exec- (execution), param- (parameters).

category.description: Test category determines which engine subsystem is under test.

starting_parameters.description: Key-value pairs passed as workflow starting parameters.

initial_properties.description: Key-value pairs pre-loaded into the Value Property store.

user_actions.description: Ordered list of user interactions to simulate during execution.

step_oid.description: OID of the step receiving the user action.

form_values.description: Key-value pairs submitted from form fields (fieldName → value).

button_output.description: The outputValue of the button pressed (for button_press action).

failure_mode.description: Failure mode for the 'fail' action (e.g., ERROR, TIMEOUT, ABORT); matched against a step's try_specifications.

error.description: Optional human-readable error message accompanying a 'fail' action.

expected.description: Expected outcomes after validation or execution.

valid.description: Whether the workflow document should pass validation.

error_code.description: Expected error code when valid is false.

execution_trace.description: Expected sequence of step state transitions.

state.description: Expected state (IDLE, WAITING, STARTING, EXECUTING, COMPLETING, COMPLETED).

after_action.description: Index into user_actions that triggered this transition.

final_properties.description: Expected Value Property store state after execution completes.
